title: Deleting a matrix names its categories and moves them to the General Matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open matrix A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Delete.
  4. Click Delete in the dialog.
  5. Open Settings › Categories.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers Delete.

Step 3:

  • A dialog titled "Delete" with matrix A's name opens and names category A.
  • It reads "Parts already on work orders keep their prices." and offers Cancel and Delete.

Step 4:

  • Matrix A is gone from the list.
  • The General Matrix and the other matrices are still listed.

Step 5:

  • Category A's matrix reads General Matrix.
